title: studentnomad
description: A student's travel journal — cheap flights, long walks, and many friends along the way.
hero_text: Cheap flights, long walks, and many friends along the way. Stories from the road, one country at a time.
about_text: I started the journey as a university student with a backpack, a tight budget, and a long list of places to see. Now, as a seasoned traveler, my goal is to visit every country in the world. This is where I write down everything — the good, the lost, and the delicious. Follow the journey!
